name: 墨水毛笔
description: 东方极简书法感：纯白底 + 超大楷体墨黑 + 小面积印章红。H1 42px 字距 12px 居中、H2 印章红 italic 居中、hr 细短 20% 红线、blockquote 居中无边。极致留白派（vs rice-paper-ink 重装饰派）。适合古诗文/禅意随笔/短评/书评。

styles.h1: font-size: 42px; font-weight: 500; color: #1A1A1A; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 48px; margin-bottom: 40px; letter-spacing: 12px; font-family: 'KaiTi','STKaiti','楷体',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; color: #9C1F1F; text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 24px; letter-spacing: 6px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 3px;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #9C1F1F; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #444444; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #1A1A1A; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: font-size: 16px; color: #555555; line-height: 2; text-align: center; font-style: italic; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 2px; border-left: none;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 16px; color: #555555; line-height: 2; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 2px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; height: 1px; width: 20%; background: #9C1F1F; border: none;
styles.code: background: #F5F5F0; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 90%; color: #9C1F1F; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FAFAF7; border: 1px solid #EEEEEE; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #1A1A1A; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; background: #F0F0F0; color: #666666; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1A1A1A; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 15px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #9C1F1F; background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid #9C1F1F;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #1A1A1A; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 1px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
